description: The static HTTP-egress gate (scripts/check_http_egress.py, the http-egress part of the repo-properties gate check) run by the runner over its own checkout of the reviewed tree with --json: every non-test module under the scanned trees, no network and no credential. Asserted: exit 0, status clean, zero findings and no unlisted sender (any non-GET request, urllib import, opener body, shell HTTP or, in a sender-pinned file such as operating/messages_planner.py, a second network call or another URL outside the allowlisted function), and at least the two long-standing allowlisted senders (integrations/live_source_guard.py urllib_sender) excused by the scan. Recorded: the allowlisted senders the scan excused and any allowlisted entry it did not meet (allowlisted_absent: operating/messages_planner.py post_messages until it lands). Counts and path:function names only, never source text.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check records a result. Keyless runs (tip 1185f200 + the change) print status clean, findings 0, allowlisted_count 2 and allowlisted_absent [operating/messages_planner.py:post_messages]; over the messages-api-planner candidate tree (3f924d62) allowlisted_count 3 and allowlisted_absent []. This check records what main's allowlist excuses on main. Decision: docs/decisions/messages-api-planner-q7.md. Blocked, never pass: when a required tree (integrations, operating, scripts, verify) is absent from the runner's checkout the script prints only blocked_reason scan_tree_missing and the missing tree names (exit 0, so blocked_when holds; the gate's text mode exits 1 there). optional_env names TMPDIR only to take the offline-spec form (blocked_when beside optional_env, as workspace.console_walkthrough); the script reads no setting and no credential.
